visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) In a dimly lit bedroom, a man in a black shirt and a woman in a striped long-sleeved shirt wake up abruptly in bed. Their faces show extreme panic with wide eyes and open mouths as they grab the floral-patterned duvet. The camera shakes violently to simulate instability. (2) The scene shifts to a white-walled hallway where the man and woman are huddled in a doorway. They are gripping each other and the door frame tightly; their body language is frantic and unstable. Yellow and red variety-style text overlays appear briefly. (3) In another bedroom area, two young girls, one in a white tank top and one in a white sweater, scream while lying in bed surrounded by several large plush toys including a white bunny. The lighting is low, and the camera continues to vibrate. (4) The two girls are now shown in a doorway, mimicking the adults' defensive posture. The older girl holds the younger one, and both are looking off-camera with distressed facial expressions. (5) The entire family of four is now gathered on the floor underneath a light-colored wooden dining table. The setting is a modern living room with a shelf of toys and figurines in the background. They are all crouching low, covering their heads or holding each other. (6) A close-up shot focuses on the man under the table. His expression shifts from panic to a calm, instructional look as he speaks directly toward the others. Informative text boxes with phone numbers and bullet points begin to overlay the bottom half of the frame. (7) The earthquake simulation seems to end. The man attempts to crawl out from under the table onto the tiled floor, but his legs buckle, and he collapses into a seated position against a black fireplace structure. The two girls watch from under the table with curious expressions. (8) The video concludes with a static white screen displaying a green and gold logo for the National Land Management Agency along with Chinese and English text.

(5) [Subtitle]: 彤彤妳先走. 不行姊姊妳先走. 姊妳先走. (6) [Subtitle]: 啊啊啊~~~ 啊~大地震. (7) [Subtitle]: 老公這次的地震好大啊，我們家房子會不會倒掉啊? 啊~我的寶貝們. 啊~我的名牌包. 啊~我的偶像週邊. 啊~我的零食. (8) [Subtitle]: 啊~我嚇到腿軟了. (9) [Subtitle]: 腳可以軟，但房子的腳可不能軟哦. (10) [Subtitle]: 對啊我們老師說，如果是軟腳蝦建築，地震來的時候是很危險的. (11) [Subtitle]: 放心~現在政府有推動私有建築物耐震弱層補強. 最高補助450萬元. 諮詢專線 (02)-6630-0237. 還可以透過專線免費諮詢. 讓我們房子的腳更加強壯哦!. (12) [Subtitle]: 地震好像停了欸. (13) [Subtitle]: 爸比你怎麼了? 我腳軟了... (14) [Logo]: 內政部國土管理署 National Land Management Agency. Ministry of the Interior. 廣告.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A loud, continuous low-frequency rumbling sound begins immediately, mimicking seismic activity. A sharp, high-pitched female scream cuts through the rumbling. A male voice shouts 'Da di zhen!' with high intensity and rapid speed. (2) The rumbling continues with percussive thuds as the man pants heavily and urges 'Kuai kuai kuai' in a strained, frantic tone. (3) New high-pitched screams from younger children are added to the mix. The rumbling becomes more chaotic, featuring the sound of rustling bedding. (4) Overlapping voices of family members arguing about who should escape first create a dense, high-arousal vocal atmosphere over the persistent rumble. (5) Sounds of sobbing and sharp intakes of breath are audible. The rumbling reaches a peak volume as voices list personal belongings in a panicked, high-pitch cadence. (6) The low-frequency rumble abruptly stops. The acoustic floor clears, and the man's voice drops to a moderate, calm pitch and normal conversational volume, explaining government policies. (7) A dull percussive thud occurs as the man attempts to move. Younger voices express concern with a rising intonation. The man's voice sounds exhausted and slightly muffled. (8) A short, bright digital jingle plays as the video ends, marking a transition to the government branding.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Chaos -> Resolution -> Call to Action
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: This video uses a comedic family skit about a simulated earthquake to grab attention and then transition into a public service announcement regarding government subsidies for earthquake-proofing buildings in Taiwan.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The video explicitly promotes a government program with contact information and a logo at the end.
